Compute-owned extensible JSON bag written exclusively by the monitoring health compute (health, currentState, decision layer/reason/evidence/trail, previous state, dl* status). Physically separated from monitoringmetadata (owned by the delta-sync write path) so the compute never clobbers the write-path heartbeat under concurrency.

Precomputed roll-up health tier for this table; holds only one of three labels: Healthy, Delayed, Failed. Written by MonitoringHealthComputeJob every 15 min. The detailed current state is stored in the monitoringcompute column; its currentState values are: Healthy, Syncing, Stale, TransientError, Crashed, Failed, LinkIssue, Unknown.

Extensible JSON key/value bag of monitoring data written by the monitoring health compute. Always contains updatedTime (heartbeat, refreshed every run) plus a snapshot of computed monitoring fields (health, error*, sync duration, record counts, consecutive counters, lastStartedTime). New keys can be added without a schema change.
